text:
Samir K.: 🚨 Seeing a spike of 5xxs from the tokenizer service in eu-west1 over the last 10m. Root cause looks like an edge case in the tokenizer for long system prompts. Patch ready: `tokenizer@v2.1.3-hotfix` (small bounds check). Can we get an out-of-window expedited deploy? Need pin + short canary-skip to restore traffic.
deploy-bot: release pipeline queued for `tokenizer@v2.1.3-hotfix`. Canary by default: 1% for 10m. To skip canary, reply `approve-skip` +2 approvers required. Logs: https://internal.logs/xyz (redacted)
Jess R.: @Samir thanks for the callout. What's current user impact (errors/sec, pct of requests)? Do we have a clear rollback plan if the fix regresses? :thinking_face:
Samir K.: current 5xx rate ~1.8% overall, spikes up to 6% for certain prompt lengths. Affects hosted API and any Dedicated clusters routed to eu-west1. Rollback plan: pin back to `tokenizer@v2.1.2` and immediate global rollback via deploy-bot. Health check: 200 OK ratio and latency P95 < 350ms.
Alex P.: Product note — customer-facing incidents are starting to accumulate in the support queue, need fast patch. I approve expedited deploy if SRE/Oncall agree to monitor for 30m post-deploy and have rollback criteria documented here.
Ops Oncall: oncall here. We can accept an out-of-window deploy with conditions: (1) pin to dedicated capacity pool for first 5m to limit blast radius, (2) skip canary allowed but only with 2 eng approvals, (3) automatic rollback if 5xx > 2% sustained for 3 consecutive minutes. I'll watch metrics dashboard and give shout if threshold triggers. :eyes:
Maria L.: +1 to expedite, I'll run the smoke test checklist after deploy: `smoke/tokenizer/basic`, `smoke/tokenizer/long-prompts`, `smoke/integration/chat`. Will report PASS/FAIL in this thread.
Ryan G.: Jess, I'm +1 for skip-canary here. We should add a short feature-flag toggle in case we need to disable the new bounds check without full rollback. Can we ship a toggle? It'd be a quick config flip.
Jess R.: @Ryan good call — Samir, can you add the runtime toggle (env `TOKENIZER_HOTFIX_ENABLED`) and default to `true` for the rollout? If not, I still approve but prefer the toggle.
Samir K.: added toggle, will default true. Config endpoint ready: `PUT /cfg/tokenizer?TOKENIZER_HOTFIX_ENABLED=false` (auth required).
deploy-bot: Received approvals: Alex P., Maria L., Ryan G. 2/2 required for skip-canary satisfied. Initiating deploy: canary-skip=true, pin-to-pool=dedicated-eu-west1-small, ttl=5m. Starting at 2212345775.
deploy-bot: Pre-deploy smoke: `smoke/tokenizer/basic` -> PASS, `smoke/tokenizer/long-prompts` -> PASS, `smoke/integration/chat` -> PASS.
deploy-bot: Canary skipped. Deploy progressing to 100% on pinned pool. Watch IDs: dashboard:/dash/alerts/tokenizer-eu, traces:/traces/abc
Maria L.: smoke checks re-run after push: basic=PASS, long-prompts=PASS, integration=PASS. No new 5xx observed in the first 90s.
Ops Oncall: Monitoring: 5xx currently 0.6%, P95 latency 310ms. Keeping watch for 30m window.
deploy-bot: Deploy finished at 2212345870. Version `tokenizer@v2.1.3-hotfix` active on pinned pool. Auto-unpin scheduled at 2212346170 (5m ttl).
Samir K.: thanks all. Continuing to watch. If anyone sees anomalies drop a note here and I'll flip `TOKENIZER_HOTFIX_ENABLED=false` and trigger rollback.
Jess R.: Marking as expedited deploy approved. Please add a one-line release note: "Fix bounds check on tokenizer to prevent 5xx for long prompts (v2.1.3-hotfix)" and tag incident if any customer hits persisted errors.
Alex P.: I pushed the release note to the release-notes doc and notified support. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Auto-unpin executed at 2212346170. Post-deploy health at 2212345980: 5xx=0.4%, P95=305ms. Closing thread unless new issues reported. :white_check_mark:
